products.name: Fiddler AI
products.note: Model performance management; explainability; bias detection; drift monitoring; LLM observability

profile_text.body:
Fiddler describes itself as an AI Control Plane for enterprise use, offering visibility, monitoring, enforcement, and governance across both agentic and predictive AI deployments. The platform is designed for organizations in financial services, healthcare, insurance, and government, and its typical users include software and AI engineers, data scientists, platform and DevOps teams, and security and compliance teams. The company positions its offering as model- and cloud-agnostic, stating compatibility with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, and more than 100 other providers.

The core product, Fiddler AI, covers model performance management, explainability, bias detection, drift monitoring, and LLM observability. A central component is Fiddler Centor Models, which the company says run within a customer's own environment to power guardrails and evaluations without external LLM API calls. Fiddler claims this approach reduces evaluation total cost of ownership by up to 98% compared to foundation models. The platform also detects and redacts PII, PHI, and secrets at the prompt and response level, and records every enforcement decision for audit purposes aligned with GRC standards and AI regulations.

The site's held facts confirm Fiddler is categorized under AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms, with Fiddler AI as its tracked product. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
